name: pattern match with failure links
mechanism: precompute for each pattern prefix the longest proper prefix that is also a suffix, so that after a mismatch the scan resumes at that prefix without re-reading text characters; a trie of many patterns gives one automaton for all

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Knuth–Morris–Pratt algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Substrings: substring search which bypasses reexamination of matched characters
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Aho–Corasick string matching algorithm': trie based algorithm for finding all substring matches to any of a finite set of strings

requires: a preprocessing pass over the pattern(s)
fails_when: preprocessing cost per pattern set change
